Q5391.reason: Spastic paraplegia is an upper-motor-neuron pattern (increased tone); MS is a classic cause, while proprioceptive loss, true incoordination, and flaccid tone are not features of the pattern.

Q5392.reason: Tension-type headache is the most common cause of headache; neck stiffness is not always meningitis, pain severity does not equal life threat, and temporal arteritis associates with PMR rather than RA.

Q5397.reason: Statutory rape is strict liability as to age, so voluntary intoxication cannot negate culpability, whereas the other charges are specific-intent crimes that intoxication can negate.
